In 2020, I started Project Blueprint to help you achieve similar results.  I share everything I do and learn for free, so you can access the best health science available.

Project Blueprint and Don’t Die celebrate that we, humanity, are evolving into something new. Join me on this journey.

segments.text: it absolutely pains me to tell you I grew up consuming this in the morning it was a cereal like this 17 g of sugar one and 1/3 cup I probably had three cups and maybe one or two of these but this was the main stay in my house sugar cereal was what we had for breakfast every day then after school we get soda at the local gas station 64 o was just about right altogether I was probably consuming around 100 to 150 g of sugar every day now I do not blame my mother

or my community they just didn't know that was the norm that's what these companies delivered I blame these who implanted the sugar in our lives and ruined so much of our potential in life because we were feeding on their addiction it is evil it's awful and it has to stop
